# Keyboard Shortcuts

The shortcut registry is centralized in `phage_annotator.ui_qt.keyboard_registry`.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+O` | Open files |
| `Ctrl+Alt+O` | Open folder |
| `Ctrl+S` | Save project |
| `Ctrl+Shift+S` | Save annotations CSV |
| `Ctrl+Alt+L` | Load project |
| `Ctrl+Z` | Undo |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Z` | Redo |
| `Ctrl+E` | Export view |
| `F1` | Keyboard shortcuts |
| `Ctrl+Space` | Play or pause time playback |
| `Alt+Left` / `Alt+Right` | Navigate time |
| `Alt+Up` / `Alt+Down` | Navigate z |
| `A` | Accept suggestion |
| `Shift+A` | Accept focused suggestion |
| `R` | Reject suggestion |
| `N` | Next suggestion |
| `P` | Previous suggestion |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Delete` | Clear ROI |
| `Delete` | Delete selected annotation |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Q` | Run QC validation |
| `Ctrl+Alt+D` | Toggle diagnostics |
